name: 顧客一覧の固定クイックフィルター帯
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied HubSpot quick-filter strip as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact source crop is 1060x52 pixels (20.38:1), an ultra-wide, shallow toolbar row. Preserve all controls in a single horizontal line at the same compact height. Do not add surrounding page, tab strip, search field, or extra filters.

From left to right, render four teal text dropdown controls, each with a small downward caret: 「コンタクト担当者」, 「作成日」, 「最終アクティビティ日」, and 「リードステータス」. Next show a small plus icon with 「その他」. At the far right, after a fine vertical divider, show the small teal filter/list icon followed by 「詳細フィルター」. Keep the broad uneven spacing between controls and match their source alignment.

Use the source's white background, compact medium-weight teal-blue sans-serif labels, tiny carets, restrained icon size, 52 px total row height, and long horizontal distribution. Keep every label on one line. No rounded chip backgrounds, filled buttons, separators other than the subtle divider before Advanced filters, extra icons, or added text. Preserve the target 1060x52 aspect ratio without blank bands; use the crop as the authority for order, spacing, and appearance.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves all six quick-filter controls in the correct order, but ImageGen returned 1792x877 (2.04:1) with large blank bands and compressed spacing instead of the source 1060x52 (20.38:1). Prior extreme-wide outputs also failed their target geometry and reframe attempts did not help, so recorded needs-correction after one attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
